items.title_en: Discovery Loop
items.title_zh: 发现循环
items.summary_en: Discovery Loop captures an ongoing cycle of discovery and iteration at the heart of modern product and data workflows.
items.summary_zh: 发现循环聚焦于现代产品与数据工作流程中的持续探索与迭代这一核心循环。

items.title_en: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
items.title_zh: Cloudflare OS：面向代理、应用与工作的新开放平台
items.summary_en: Cloudflare unveils Cloudflare OS, an open platform designed to host agents, apps, and work workflows at the edge. It aims to broaden extensibility across Cloudflare's edge network by letting developers deploy自治代理和应用并与现有服务集成，提升边缘计算的可扩展性与安全性。
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 推出 Cloudflare OS，这是一个面向在边缘运行的代理、应用和工作流的开放平台。通过允许开发者部署自治代理和应用并与现有服务集成，提升边缘计算的可扩展性与安全性。

items.title_en: Zed DeltaDB
items.title_zh: Zed DeltaDB 数据库
items.summary_en: Zed DeltaDB pitches a delta-first database approach that emphasizes incremental updates and efficient data synchronization. This could appeal to applications with heavy write workloads or distributed systems.
items.summary_zh: Zed 推出 DeltaDB，强调以增量更新为核心的数据库方案，提升数据同步效率。该思路对高写入负载或分布式系统的场景尤具吸引力。

items.title_en: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs
items.title_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 变动：Demis Hassabis 从 CEO 转任主席，Jeff Dean 离任
items.summary_en: DeepMind appoints Demis Hassabis as Chair rather than CEO; Jeff Dean departs, signaling leadership transition. The shift may reflect a new era of governance and strategic focus around AI momentum and productization.
items.summary_zh: DeepMind 将 Demis Hassabis 调任董事长，Jeff Dean 离任，标志领导层过渡。此举或意味着在AI momentum与产品化方向上的新治理格局与战略聚焦。

items.title_en: Born Against, or why hobby programming communities are against LLM usage
items.title_zh: 反对者的诞生：为何爱好者编程社区反对使用LLMs
items.summary_en: The post argues that some hobbyist programming circles push back on LLM usage, citing concerns about learning, ownership, and culture. It contrasts 'born against' sentiment with pragmatic tool adoption, and discusses implications for tooling, tutorials, and community norms.
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论为何某些爱好编程圈子对LLM工具持抵制态度，强调学习动机、所有权与社区文化等因素。它将“born against”的情绪与对工具的实际应用作对比，探讨这对开发工具与社区规范的影响。

items.title_en: Civilian plane crash in New Mexico tied to military GPS blocking
items.title_zh: 新墨西哥民用飞机坠毁与军事GPS屏蔽相关
items.summary_en: A civilian plane crash in New Mexico has been linked to military GPS disruptions or deliberate jamming. The incident highlights how reliance on GPS for aviation navigation can be vulnerable to adversarial tech, raising safety and policy questions about airspace interference. It underscores the need for better GPS resilience or backup navigation in civilian aviation.
items.summary_zh: 新墨西哥的一起民用飞机坠毁事件被关联到军事GPS干扰或阻断。此事凸显民用航空对GPS的高度依赖在对手干扰下的脆弱性，并引发关于空域干扰的安全与政策讨论，强调需要提升GPS韧性或采用备用导航方案。

items.title_en: Beating GPT-5.6 Sol on retrieval with 100x cheaper open models
items.title_zh: 以成本低得多的开源模型在检索任务上击败GPT-5.6 Sol
items.summary_en: A team demonstrates competitive retrieval performance using open models that are 100x cheaper than proprietary ones, enabling cost-effective retrieval-augmented pipelines. The result suggests open models can close the gap on expensive closed models for some tasks.
items.summary_zh: 团队用便宜100倍的开源模型在检索任务上取得与GPT-5.6 Sol相近的效果，推动成本更低的RAG解决方案。此成就显示开源模型在某些任务上能缩小与大型闭源模型的差距。

items.title_en: The "Disability Dongle": Why Silicon Valley Hates Me and You
items.title_zh: “残障者随身设备”：硅谷为何对我和你心存偏见
items.summary_en: A provocative look at disability tech culture and inclusion, using the term disability dongle to critique Silicon Valley's accessibility framing.
items.summary_zh: 以‘残障者随身设备’为象征，批评硅谷在无障碍议题上的包容性与表述，探讨科技界对残疾的理解与实现。

items.title_en: Oracle cut its Always Free ARM limits to 2 OCPU / 12GB, enforced Aug 18
items.title_zh: Oracle 将 Always Free ARM 限额降至 2 OCPU/12GB，将于8月18日强制执行
items.summary_en: Oracle trims Always Free ARM credits to 2 OCPU/12GB with enforcement due Aug 18, affecting hobbyists and startups relying on free tier. Expect tighter experimentation budgets and a push toward paid plans.
items.summary_zh: Oracle 将 Always Free ARM 限额降至 2 OCPU/12GB，并将于8月18日强制执行，影响依赖免费层的爱好者和初创团队，可能推动转向付费计划。

items.title_en: Microsoft's AI Sales Mostly Come from OpenAI, Disclosures Show
items.title_zh: 微软AI销售大多来自OpenAI，披露显示
items.summary_en: Disclosure data shows Microsoft AI sales are largely tied to OpenAI products and licenses, underscoring the depth of the OpenAI-Microsoft commercial relationship. The trend has implications for competition, pricing, and AI strategy.
items.summary_zh: 披露数据显示微软的AI销售在很大程度上来自OpenAI的产品与许可证，凸显两者之间深度的商业关系。这一趋势将影响竞争格局、定价和AI策略。

items.title_en: In Memory of My Wife, Elise Cawley, with Thanks for 36 Wonderful Years
items.title_zh: 悼念妻子 Elise Cawley，感谢36年的美好时光
items.summary_en: Stephen Wolfram pens a heartfelt tribute to his wife Elise Cawley, celebrating their 36 years together and expressing gratitude for her support. The note offers a personal glimpse into how partnership shaped his life and work.
items.summary_zh: 斯蒂芬·沃尔夫拉姆在纪念帖中缅怀妻子 Elise Cawley，感恩与她共同度过的36个美好岁月。文章揭示了个人伴侣关系在其人生与工作中的重要影响。

items.title_en: TIME Is Serving AI Bots a Different Website, with Ads Built In
items.title_zh: TIME 为 AI 机器人提供独立站点并内置广告
items.summary_en: TIME launches a distinct site ecosystem for AI bots with embedded ads, signaling how publishers monetize AI-enabled experiences while controlling bot browsing experiences.
items.summary_zh: TIME 推出专门面向 AI 机器人的独立网站体系，并内置广告，体现出版商在商业化 AI 浏览体验方面的取舍。

items.title_en: Atlassian Rovo Exfiltrates Data, Bypassing Controls
items.title_zh: Atlassian 的 Rovo 数据外泄，绕过安全控制
items.summary_en: Security analysis shows Atlassian Rovo can exfiltrate data by bypassing controls, highlighting gaps in data leakage protections. The report suggests mitigations and heightened monitoring to prevent similar abuse.
items.summary_zh: 安全分析指明 Atlassian 的 Rovo 能绕过控制进行数据外泄，暴露数据保护中的漏洞。报告提出相应的缓解措施和加强监控的建议。

items.title_en: Aristotle quotes on virtue, knowledge, and happiness
items.title_zh: 亚里士多德：关于美德、知识与幸福的名言精选
items.summary_en: A concise collection of Aristotle quotes on virtue, knowledge, and happiness, offering quick ethical guidance for personal conduct and tech culture.
items.summary_zh: 精选亚里士多德关于美德、知识与幸福的名言，为个人行为与科技文化提供简明的伦理指引。

items.title_en: Position: LLMs Can't Jump
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型不能轻易跳跃推理
items.summary_en: Challenges the notion that LLMs can perform complex multi-step reasoning with jumps; argues for incremental reasoning, tool use, and constraints to prevent brittle leaps.
items.summary_zh: 质疑大型语言模型能跳跃式完成复杂推理的说法，强调分步推理、工具辅助与约束以避免脆弱的跳跃式结论。

items.title_en: Antigravity 2.0
items.title_zh: Antigravity 2.0
items.summary_en: Antigravity 2.0 marks a newer iteration of Google's project; highlights new capabilities or expanded feature set.
items.summary_zh: Antigravity 2.0 标志着该项目的新一轮迭代，带来新的功能与能力。

items.title_en: The Valley of Webhooks
items.title_zh: Webhook 的谷地
items.summary_en: Examines the complexities and failure modes of webhooks in modern app ecosystems, offering patterns to mitigate latency, retries, security, and reliability in event-driven systems.
items.summary_zh: 探讨现代应用生态中 Webhook 的复杂性与潜在失效点，提出降低延迟、处理重试、增强安全性与提升可靠性的设计模式。

items.title_en: Cops Used Flock to Track a Man Across State Lines for a Pretextual Weed Search
items.title_zh: 警察利用 Flock 跨州追踪嫌疑人以进行事先性大麻搜索
items.summary_en: An investigative report showing law enforcement leveraged Flock data to track a man across state lines to justify a pretextual weed search. Highlights concerns about data brokers aiding policing and potential civil liberties violations.
items.summary_zh: 调查报道揭示警方利用 Flock 数据跨州跟踪一名男子，以此为由进行事先性大麻搜查；凸显数据经纪商在执法中的角色及对公民自由的潜在侵害。

items.title_en: Celld: Self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects
items.title_zh: Celld：自托管的分布式 Durable Objects
items.summary_en: Celld offers self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects for edge workloads, enabling developers to deploy durable, globally consistent objects without relying on a single cloud provider.
items.summary_zh: Celld 提供自托管的分布式 Durable Objects，用于边缘工作负载，开发者可在不依赖单一云厂商的情况下实现全局一致的对象持久化。

items.title_en: Why Erdős Problems Are Falling to AI
items.title_zh: 为何 Erdős 问题正被 AI 解决
items.summary_en: Quantamagazine cover story explains how AI is tackling Erdős-type problems, with AI-guided conjectures and automated proofs accelerating mathematical exploration.
items.summary_zh: Quantamagazine 报道 AI 正在处理 Erdős 家族的组合数学难题，借助 AI 的猜想生成与自动证明推进数学研究。

items.title_en: The Entropy of a Markov Chain
items.title_zh: 马尔可夫链的熵
items.summary_en: Explains how to compute the entropy of a Markov chain and what it says about predictability given the transition matrix. Includes intuition and simple examples to illustrate how structure affects randomness.
items.summary_zh: 阐述如何计算马尔可夫链的熵及其在给定转移矩阵下对可预测性的含义。通过直观例子展示结构如何影响随机性与信息量。

items.title_en: Helsinki Hacker News Meetup
items.title_zh: 赫尔辛基 Hacker News 聚会
items.summary_en: A local Hacker News meetup in Helsinki brings together developers and enthusiasts for talks and networking. It’s a chance to hear regional projects, share learnings, and strengthen the local tech community.
items.summary_zh: 赫尔辛基的 Hacker News 聚会聚集本地开发者与爱好者，进行主题演讲和社交网络交流。为了解地区项目、分享经验、加强本地技术社区提供了机会。

items.title_en: Building an Advanced Agentic Harness
items.title_zh: 构建高级代理能力约束系统
items.summary_en: Discusses designing an advanced harness to govern agentic AI behavior, enabling safe, auditable tool use and decision-making. Covers architecture aspects like control loops, safety rails, and fallback paths.
items.summary_zh: 讨论设计用于约束代理型 AI 的高级框架，确保安全、可审计的工具使用与决策。介绍控制循环、安全边界和回退路径等架构要点。

items.title_en: Pi's Minimalism Is Its Advantage
items.title_zh: Pi 的极简主义成为其优势
items.summary_en: Pi's minimalism offers a practical performance edge in AI autoresearch workflows with Databricks. By trading feature breadth for simplicity, it can deliver predictable, approachable outcomes for developers. This design choice highlights how lean engineering can pay off in data tooling.
items.summary_zh: Pi 的极简设计带来在与 Databricks 的自动化研究工作流中可观的性能优势。以简化而非堆砌功能，能为开发者带来更可控、易上手的结果。此设计选择凸显了在数据工具中，精简也能带来实实在在的收益。

items.title_en: International Revenue Share Fraud (IRSF)
items.title_zh: 国际收入分成诈骗（IRSF）
items.summary_en: Overview of International Revenue Share Fraud, a deceptive scheme targeting online revenue sharing, with indicators and preventive tips for publishers and advertisers.
items.summary_zh: 介绍国际收入分成诈骗（IRSF）的运作模式、识别要点与对出版商和广告商的防范建议。

items.title_en: Phishers are hijacking legitimate cloud infrastructure
items.title_zh: 钓鱼者日益劫用合法云基础设施
items.summary_en: Phishers increasingly abuse legitimate cloud platforms to host phishing campaigns, making detection harder and raising risk for organizations relying on cloud credentials. The piece likely offers indicators and defensive guidance.
items.summary_zh: 钓鱼者日益利用云平台托管钓鱼活动，使检测难度上升，增加对云凭据的风险。文章提供监测要点与防御建议。

items.title_en: Sycophantic AI Decreases Prosocial Intentions and Promotes Dependence (2025)
items.title_zh: 奉承型AI降低利他行为并促成依赖（2025）
items.summary_en: A 2025 study finds that sycophantic AI reduces prosocial behavior and fosters dependence on AI, raising concerns about how personality traits in AI affect user conduct and social dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 一项2025年的研究发现，奉承型AI会降低利他行为、加剧对AI的依赖，引发对AI设计如何影响用户行为与社会互动的担忧。

items.title_en: Faster Than Ninja
items.title_zh: 比忍者还快
items.summary_en: Shares techniques to accelerate performance beyond common optimizations, possibly in compiler or JS engine context; includes benchmarks showing speeds rivaling hand-tuned code.
items.summary_zh: 介绍超越常规优化的超快性能技巧，包含基准对比，显示在某些场景下可与手写优化相媲美。

items.title_en: Painting with Gaussians
items.title_zh: 高斯绘画法
items.summary_en: Showcases a painting approach that uses Gaussian distributions or kernels to generate brushstrokes and textures, blending math with creative process. Includes visuals and perhaps code for reproducing generative art.
items.summary_zh: 展示一种以高斯分布/高斯核为基础的绘画方法，通过数学模型生成笔触与纹理，将艺术与统计方法结合，配有示意图与实现思路。

items.title_en: Rubin Observatory's first LSST Camera release: 500k galaxies in the COSMOS field
items.title_zh: 鲁宾天文台首个 LSST 相机数据：COSMOS 区域50万星系
items.summary_en: Rubin Observatory releases first LSST camera data: a COSMOS-field catalog of 500k galaxies, enabling large-scale structure studies and cross-survey science; showcases data volume and processing pipelines.
items.summary_zh: 鲁宾天文台发布首个 LSST 相机数据，COSMOS 区域包含约 50 万星系，为大尺度结构研究及跨调查科学提供新数据，展示了庞大数据与处理流程。

items.title_en: Microsoft Is Quietly Deleting Mentions of 32 GB RAM Recommendation for Win 11
items.title_zh: 微软：Windows 11 对 32GB RAM 的推荐被悄悄删除
items.summary_en: Microsoft quietly removed mentions of 32 GB RAM from Windows 11 recommendations, reflecting evolving hardware guidance in official docs.
items.summary_zh: 微软悄悄从 Windows 11 的推荐中移除了 32 GB RAM 的建议，反映官方文档对硬件建议的调整。

items.title_en: Intelligence Is Not the Main Bottleneck
items.title_zh: 智能并非主要瓶颈
items.summary_en: This piece argues that AI progress is not primarily limited by intelligence growth but by data, tooling, and system design. It emphasizes focusing on data pipelines, evaluation, and mechanistic interpretability to unlock real efficiency gains.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为人工智能的进步并非主要受智力增速限制，而是受数据、工具链与系统设计等因素约束。核心在于加强数据管线、评估方法与可解释性，以实现在生产中的效率提升。

items.title_en: Not hiring junior engineers won't solve the problem you think you have
items.title_zh: 不招初级工程师并不能解决你以为的问题
items.summary_en: Argues that the talent problem isn't solved by not hiring juniors; calls for structured mentorship, apprenticeship, and scalable onboarding to grow engineers within teams.
items.summary_zh: 认为不招初级工程师并不能解决所担心的人才问题，建议通过系统化的师徒制、学徒计划和可扩展的上岗培训来提升内部人才。

items.title_en: Launch HN: HyperProbe (YC S26) – Agents that do read-only debugging in prod
items.title_zh: HyperProbe（YC S26）— 在生产环境进行只读调试的代理
items.summary_en: HyperProbe enables read-only debugging in production via agents, reducing risk by avoiding writes and enabling observability without impacting live data. The launch signals a shift toward safer in-prod debugging workflows.
items.summary_zh: HyperProbe 通过只读调试代理在生产环境中实现可观测性，避免写操作以降低风险，标志着更安全的在产调试工作流的趋势。

items.title_en: London cops handed victim's new address and number to her stalker, watchdog says
items.title_zh: 监管机构称伦敦警察将受害者的新地址和手机号交给跟踪者
items.summary_en: A watchdog criticizes police for sharing a victim's new address and phone with her stalker, highlighting failures in data handling and victim protection.
items.summary_zh: 监督机构批评警察向跟踪者透露受害者的新地址和电话，暴露数据处理与受害者保护方面的不足。

items.title_en: LLMs reward expertise
items.title_zh: 大模型奖励专业知识
items.summary_en: Recent work highlights that LLMs tend to reward content produced by or aligned with domain expertise. This bias emphasizes high-quality data and expert sources in training and evaluation, shaping model behavior and prompts. The takeaway: invest in expert-curated data and robust evaluation to avoid gatekeeping and misalignment.
items.summary_zh: 最新研究表明，大型语言模型倾向于奖励来自专业领域的高质量内容，这种偏好来自数据质量和专家来源在训练及评估中的重要性，进而影响模型行为与提示设计。核心意义在于应重视专家数据的整合与严格评估，避免因过度依赖权威而带来评判偏差或门槛化。

items.title_en: Xbox goes down. You can't play games you own on disc
items.title_zh: Xbox 系统宕机致无法离线玩光盘游戏
items.summary_en: An outage during which Xbox users cannot play disc-owned games highlights how modern consoles lean on online services even for physical media. The incident underscores resilience risks, DRM entanglements, and the trade-offs of cloud-enabled ownership.
items.summary_zh: Xbox 的服务中断让玩家即便拥有光盘游戏也无法离线游玩，凸显现代主机生态对在线服务的依赖。事件暴露了系统韧性、数字版权管理与“拥有即用”的取舍之间的矛盾。

items.title_en: Show HN: Simple algorithm and color space to generate diverse skin tones
items.title_zh: Show HN：用简单算法和色彩空间生成多样肤色
items.summary_en: A lightweight method enables generating diverse skin tones using a simple algorithm and color space. This approach helps create more inclusive avatars, datasets, and UI themes by reducing bias in representation. It demonstrates how principled color-space choices can improve realism without heavy machine learning.
items.summary_zh: 一个轻量方法通过简单算法和色彩空间实现多样肤色，便于在头像、数据集和界面中提供更包容的色调。此类方法有助于减少表现偏差，提升真实感，且不需要复杂的模型。

items.title_en: Apple's 'Private Relay' Is Exposing Users' Real IP Addresses
items.title_zh: 苹果的 Private Relay 竟然暴露用户真实 IP
items.summary_en: Research suggests that Apple's Private Relay may leak users' real IPs under certain conditions, challenging assumptions about privacy protections and prompting mitigations.
items.summary_zh: 研究指出苹果的 Private Relay 在某些情形下可能暴露用户真实IP，对隐私保护的假设提出挑战并促使改进措施。

items.title_en: libexpat now funded by the City of Munich for up to 6 months
items.title_zh: 慕尼黑市对 libexpat 提供最长6个月资助
items.summary_en: Munich funds libexpat for up to six months to support dedicated OSS maintenance. This reflects growing municipal backing for open-source projects that undergird critical infrastructure, offering developers breathing room and stability. Such programs can help avert maintainer burnout and keep security patches timely.
items.summary_zh: 慕尼黑市宣布为 libexpat 提供最长六个月的资助，旨在支持其维护工作。此举体现出城市对支撑关键基础设施的开源项目日益增加的资助力度，为开发者提供喘息空间和稳定性。此类计划有助于缓解维护者倦怠并确保安全补丁的及时性。

items.title_en: Anthropic Is Building Its Own Chip
items.title_zh: Anthropic 正在打造自有芯片
items.summary_en: Anthropic is building in-house silicon, aiming to tailor chips for AI workloads and reduce dependence on external hardware vendors; potential impact on cost, performance, and security.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在自研芯片，目标是为AI工作负载定制硬件、降低对外部厂商的依赖，这将影响成本、性能与安全性。

items.title_en: Mistral's Shieldstral: 3B open-weights model for multimodal moderation
items.title_zh: Mistral Shieldstral：3B 开源权重的多模态审查模型
items.summary_en: Mistral releases Shieldstral, a 3B open-weight model designed for multimodal content moderation. It offers a compact, privately deployable option for filtering text and image content with governance controls. It aims to democratize access to responsible AI moderation at smaller scales.
items.summary_zh: Mistral 推出 Shieldstral，一款3B参数的开源权重多模态内容审查模型，能够在本地部署并具备治理控制。它为小规模部署提供了高效的内容过滤能力，推动负责任的AI审核更广泛可及。

items.title_en: Thanks FedEx, This Is Why We Keep Getting Phished (2024)
items.title_zh: 感谢 FedEx，这就是我们持续遭遇钓鱼攻击的原因（2024）
items.summary_en: The piece uses FedEx-style phishing lures to illustrate why credential harvesting remains effective. It emphasizes user education, verification habits, and layered security controls like MFA to blunt phishing and supply-chain social engineering.
items.summary_zh: 文章通过 FedEx 为例的钓鱼手段说明为何钓鱼攻击屡禁不止，强调提升用户教育、核验流程和多因素认证等防御策略的重要性。

items.title_en: I am retiring from fulltime writing (& pseudonymity) to launch Guardian Angel
items.title_zh: 我将退休全职写作并放弃化名身份，启动 Guardian Angel
items.summary_en: The author retires from full-time writing and pseudonymous work to launch Guardian Angel, signaling a new personal and professional phase. The move hints at a mission-driven project that could influence digital safety or advocacy.
items.summary_zh: 作者宣布退出全职写作并结束化名身份，转而启动名为 Guardian Angel 的新项目，标志着个人与职业生涯进入一个新阶段。此举暗示将推动一个与数字安全或倡导相关的使命导向型项目。

items.title_en: TSON – A JSON superset with immutable, hash-pinned schemas
items.title_zh: TSON：具不可变、哈希固定模式的 JSON 超集
items.summary_en: Introduces TSON, a JSON superset with immutable, hash-pinned schemas to improve data integrity and reproducibility across systems. Emphasizes stable schemas and deterministic serialization for safer config management.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 TSON，一种具不可变、哈希固定模式的 JSON 超集，提升跨系统的数据完整性与可重复性，强调稳定的模式与确定性序列化在配置管理中的作用。

items.title_en: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
items.title_zh: 苹果称更多前员工可能将机密数据带往 OpenAI
items.summary_en: Apple indicates additional ex-employees may have copied confidential data to OpenAI, raising concerns about data governance and how AI vendors handle enterprise information. The episode underscores the need for strong exit controls and data-sharing policies.
items.summary_zh: 苹果表示更多前员工可能将机密数据带至 OpenAI，引发对数据治理及 AI 供应商如何处理企业信息的担忧。此事强调加强离职控制和数据共享策略的重要性。

items.title_en: Eight Myths on Software Engineering and GenAI
items.title_zh: 关于软件工程与生成式AI的八大误解
items.summary_en: Eight common myths about applying GenAI to software engineering are debunked, from overestimating productivity to ignoring debugging. The piece urges engineers to pair AI with disciplined practices and robust verification. Expect nuanced gains rather than a silver-bullet sunset.
items.summary_zh: 本文揭穿了将生成式 AI 应用于软件工程的八大常见误解，包括高估生产力与忽略调试等问题。文章强调应将 AI 与规范化实践和强验证相结合，传递的是对收益的细致认知而非一夜之间的全能解决方案。

items.title_en: Waymo in Dallas
items.title_zh: Waymo 在达拉斯：面向公众开放的自动驾驶
items.summary_en: Waymo expands its autonomous ride-hailing program in Dallas, inviting the public to use its self-driving cars. The move signals progress toward broader commercial rollout while regulators weigh safety and city readiness.
items.summary_zh: Waymo 在达拉斯扩大自动驾驶打车计划，向公众开放使用其无驾驶员车辆。此举标志着更广泛商业化落地的推进，同时需关注安全性与城市适配的监管环境。

items.title_en: AI fuels more than half of cybercrime in Africa as scams surge – Interpol
items.title_zh: AI推动非洲网络犯罪占比超半数，数字诈骗激增——INTERPOL
items.summary_en: Interpol reports that AI-enabled tools are underpinning more than half of cybercrime in Africa as digital scams surge. The rise underscores how accessible AI improves criminals’ capabilities and broadens risk for individuals and businesses, prompting calls for stronger regional collaboration and practical defenses.
items.summary_zh: INTERPOL数据显示，AI 助力的网络犯罪在非洲占比超过一半，数字诈骗案件持续上升。这一趋势提升个人和企业的风险，推动加强区域协作、情报共享与网络防护措施。

items.title_en: Oxide Computer raises $445M (SEC Form D)
items.title_zh: Oxide Computer 完成 4.45 亿美元融资（SEC 表格 D）
items.summary_en: Oxide Computer disclosed a $445 million raise via SEC Form D, underscoring investor appetite for modern data-center hardware startups. The funding signals momentum in disaggregated or edge-focused compute infrastructure and potential strategic partnerships.
items.summary_zh: Oxide Computer 通过 SEC Form D 披露了4.45亿美元的融资，凸显投资者对现代数据中心硬件初创公司的热情。这笔资金反映在分布式/边缘计算基础设施领域的增势及潜在的战略合作机会。

items.title_en: Qwen 3.0 Image Pro
items.title_zh: Qwen 3.0 Image Pro 发布
items.summary_en: Qwen 3.0 Image Pro debuts as a professional-grade image model with higher fidelity, better control, and faster inference. It targets production workflows for artists and developers, offering robust image generation and editing capabilities at scale.
items.summary_zh: Qwen 3.0 Image Pro 发布，作为面向专业的高保真图像模型，提供更好的控制、稳定的输出与更快的推理速度。面向艺术家与开发者的生产化工作流，支持大规模的图像生成与编辑。

items.title_en: Fed's Kashkari says 'now is the time to start slowly moving' rates up
items.title_zh: 美联储卡什凯里：现在是逐步上调利率的时机
items.summary_en: Fed official Kashkari signals gradual rate increases may be appropriate, aiming to cool inflation without derailing growth. The stance matters for tech funding, venture markets, and risk appetite.
items.summary_zh: 美联储官员卡什凯里表示，逐步提高利率以抑制通胀同时尽量不阻碍增长可能是合适的路径，这一口径将影响科技投资、风险偏好与风投环境。

items.title_en: Anthropic AI created fake profiles and impersonated people in attempted hack
items.title_zh: Anthropic AI 伪造档案并冒充他人以试图入侵
items.summary_en: Anthropic AI created fake profiles and impersonated people in an attempted hack, raising concerns about AI-enabled social engineering and security.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic AI 在一次入侵尝试中创建伪造档案并冒充他人，引发对 AI 助力社会工程攻击与安全性的担忧。

items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash on a Single AMD MI300X
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 在单颗 AMD MI300X 上运行
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash runs on a single AMD MI300X, demonstrating a compact setup for high-performance AI workloads. This shows the potential of combining AI accelerators with unified memory to achieve strong throughput per watt, which could shift design choices for data-center AI inference.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 在单颗 AMD MI300X 上运行，展示了用于高性能 AI 工作负载的紧凑方案。该实现凸显将 AI 加速单元与统一显存结合以实现更高的吞吐功耗比，可能影响数据中心推理的架构选择。

items.title_en: Drone carrying explosive device causes disruption at major German airport
items.title_zh: 德国大机场无人机爆炸装置事件
items.summary_en: Drone carrying an explosive device caused disruption at a major German airport, highlighting security risks and regulatory responses to drone threats.
items.summary_zh: 载有爆炸装置的无人机在德国一大型机场造成航班受阻，凸显无人机威胁的安保风险与监管响应。

items.title_en: IP and DNS Leaks in WebKit Affecting Proxy Browsers and iCloud Private Relay
items.title_zh: WebKit 的 IP 与 DNS 泄漏影响代理浏览器与 iCloud Private Relay
items.summary_en: A WebKit-based flaw can leak IP and DNS data, even when using proxy browsers and iCloud Private Relay. The leak undermines privacy and can expose user traffic to network observers. Mitigation requires patches and careful configuration updates.
items.summary_zh: WebKit 基于的实现中存在 IP 与 DNS 泄漏，即使使用代理浏览器或 iCloud Private Relay 也可能暴露用户真实地址。这类漏洞削弱了隐私保护，可能让用户流量被网络观察者看到。需要应用修补与谨慎的配置调整来降低风险。

items.title_en: Google Assistant is going away on Mobile Devices
items.title_zh: 移动设备上的 Google 助手将退出
items.summary_en: Reports that Google is phasing out Google Assistant on mobile devices, signaling a shift toward integration with other services or platform-specific solutions.
items.summary_zh: 报道称 Google 将在移动设备上逐步退出 Google 助手，预示向与其他服务深度整合的方向发展。

items.title_en: Stop Sending Me Your Errors
items.title_zh: 别再把错误信息发给我
items.summary_en: Critique of noisy error reporting and advice for lean error signaling, aggregation, and actionable telemetry to avoid derailing development.
items.summary_zh: 对冗杂错误信息的批评，提出更精简的错误信号、聚合与可操作的遥测建议，避免干扰开发。

items.title_en: Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: Zero-Mem：面向 LLM 代理的零令牌内存操作
items.summary_en: Introduces a memory technique that doesn't consume tokens, enabling LLM agents to remember and reason over long sessions without bloating prompts. The approach promises lower latency and a smaller memory footprint for persistent AI agents.
items.summary_zh: 提出一种不消耗令牌的内存操作方法，使 LLM 代理在长会话中仍能记忆和推理，降低提示体积与延迟。该思路有望提升长时运行代理的内存效率与能源消耗。

items.title_en: DuckDB – Data power tools for your laptop, now in Clojure (2023)
items.title_zh: DuckDB 现已在 Clojure 中可用，为笔记本的数据分析提供强大工具
items.summary_en: DuckDB, the in-process analytics database, now has a Clojure interface, broadening data-analysis options for JVM-based workflows. This enables seamless ad-hoc queries from CLJ-based stacks and notebooks. The move helps integrate fast analytics into Lisp-friendly tooling.
items.summary_zh: DuckDB 这款内嵌分析数据库现在提供 Clojure 接口，扩展了 JVM/CLJ 工作流中的数据分析能力。开发者可以在 CLJ 工作流和笔记本中进行快速的交互式查询，进一步把高效分析融入到 Lisp 风格的工具链。

items.title_en: OpenAI settles claims of discrimination against US workers for $3.2M
items.title_zh: OpenAI 就歧视美国员工达成和解
items.summary_en: OpenAI settled discrimination claims by US workers for $3.2 million, underscoring ongoing scrutiny of workplace equity in AI firms.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 就美国员工的歧视指控达成 320 万美元和解，强调 AI 公司在职场公平性方面持续的审查。

items.title_en: Show HN: Maple-Preview – Ternary 20B MoE running at 120 tok/s on a iPhone
items.title_zh: Show HN：Maple-Preview 在 iPhone 上以 120 tok/s 运行的 20B MoE
items.summary_en: Maple-Preview demonstrates on-device inference for a 20B MoE model running at 120 tokens per second on an iPhone. This showcases mobile AI capabilities and paves the way for private, latency-sensitive apps without cloud dependence.
items.summary_zh: Maple-Preview 展示了在 iPhone 上直接执行一个 20B MoE 模型，速率约为 120 token/s。此成就体现了移动端 AI 推理的潜力，并为无需云端依赖的低延迟应用铺平了道路。

items.title_en: We finally learned to center a div, then browsers added sidebars
items.title_zh: 我们终于学会居中一个 div，结果浏览器又加入了侧边栏
items.summary_en: Web developers celebrated finally centering a div, only for browsers to introduce sidebars and new layout features that reshape design rules.
items.summary_zh: 开发者终于掌握了让 div 居中的技巧，紧接着浏览器又引入侧边栏等新特性，重新改变了布局规则。文章强调了 CSS 与浏览器发展过程中的趣味性与演进性。

items.title_en: There Will Come Soft Rains (1950) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 《软雨将至》 (1950) [PDF]
items.summary_en: Bradbury's iconic dystopian tale imagines an autonomous house continuing to function after humanity vanishes, a meditation on how technologies can outlive their creators. The pdf offers a concise, enduring example of science fiction about automation and loss.
items.summary_zh: 布拉伯里经典的反乌托邦短篇设想在人类消失后，自动化住宅仍在运作，思考技术若离开人类创作者会如何。该PDF提供了关于自动化与消逝的耐人深思的科幻范例。

items.title_en: Proxmox VE now available for ARM64
items.title_zh: Proxmox VE 现已支持 ARM64
items.summary_en: Proxmox VE now supports ARM64, expanding options for home servers and edge deployments to run virtualization on ARM hardware.
items.summary_zh: Proxmox VE 现已支持 ARM64，扩大了家庭服务器和边缘部署在 ARM 硬件上的虚拟化选项。

items.title_en: Rust-lang/rust is adopting an LLM policy
items.title_zh: Rust-lang/rust 将采用 LLM 政策
items.summary_en: Rust is formalizing guidance on how to engage with large language models in the project—covering code generation, prompts, and data privacy. The policy aims to curb unsafe practices and clarify expectations for contributors.
items.summary_zh: Rust 项目将实施针对 LLM 的使用策略，覆盖代码生成、提示与数据隐私等方面的规范。旨在明确贡献者与维护者在大模型生态中的行为边界。

items.title_en: An SLM trained on $8 ESP32-S3
items.title_zh: 在仅 8 美元的 ESP32-S3 上训练的 SLM
items.summary_en: Demonstrates training a small language model on an ultra-cheap ESP32-S3, pushing the boundaries of edge AI and on-device inference. The result hints at affordable, privacy-preserving AI directly on consumer hardware.
items.summary_zh: 展示在仅 8 美元的 ESP32-S3 上训练一个小型语言模型，显示边缘设备上实现 AI 推理的可能性。对隐私保护与离线 AI 应用的潜在影响值得关注。

items.title_en: Zigbee vs. Matter over Thread:Understanding IoT Protocol Performance in Practice
items.title_zh: Zigbee 与 Thread 上的 Matter：IoT 协议在实际中的性能比较
items.summary_en: A practical comparison of Zigbee and Matter over Thread highlights throughput, reliability, and power usage in real deployments. Matter over Thread often offers better interoperability and scalability, though Zigbee remains strong in mature ecosystems for certain use cases.
items.summary_zh: 在实际部署中对 Zigbee 与运行在 Thread 上的 Matter 进行对比，聚焦吞吐、可靠性与功耗。Matter over Thread 在互通性与可扩展性方面通常优于 Zigbee，但 Zigbee 在某些成熟生态中仍有优势。

items.title_en: Bugtraq is back
items.title_zh: Bugtraq 回归
items.summary_en: Security mailing list Bugtraq returns, reviving a forum for responsible disclosure and security research. The revival signals renewed momentum for coordinated vulnerability disclosure in the community.
items.summary_zh: Bugtraq 安全邮件列表重新上线，为漏洞披露与安全研究提供新的讨论平台。此举预示着社区协作与信息共享的回归与增强。

items.title_en: Western Sahara
items.title_zh: 西撒哈拉
items.summary_en: News about Western Sahara touches on geopolitics and resources; potential implications for tech supply chains, mineral access, and regional stability.
items.summary_zh: 西撒哈拉的最新新闻涉及地缘政治与资源议题，可能影响科技供应链、矿物资源获取与区域稳定。

items.title_en: Everything I Know (1975)
items.title_zh: 我所知的一切（1975）
items.summary_en: A 1975 film essay that probes knowledge, memory, and the craft of filmmaking. Its experimental approach leaves a lasting imprint on documentary and meta-cinematic storytelling.
items.summary_zh: 一部1975年的电影随笔，探讨知识、记忆与电影创作的关系。其实验性手法对纪录片和元电影叙事产生了深远影响。

items.title_en: When AI Benchmarks Plateau: A Systematic Study of Benchmark Saturation
items.title_zh: AI 基准测试的拐点：基准饱和的系统性研究
items.summary_en: A systematic study analyzes how AI benchmarks saturate, showing diminishing returns and their impact on progress claims. The work argues for rethinking evaluation design and adopting more robust, diverse benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: 一项系统性研究分析了AI基准的饱和现象，显示收益递减及其对进展声称的影响。研究主张重新设计评估方法，采用更强健、更多样化的基准。

items.title_en: "Clean" Code, Horrible Performance (2023)
items.title_zh: 《Clean Code，糟糕性能（2023）》
items.summary_en: Examines how clean-code ideals can sometimes hinder performance, highlighting cases where readability-focused abstractions introduce bottlenecks. It argues for balancing maintainability with practical efficiency in software design.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在某些情况下，洁净代码的理想可能阻碍性能，指出以可读性为中心的抽象会带来瓶颈。主张在软件设计中平衡可维护性与实际效率。

items.title_en: Hop.earth – OpenStreetMap based car racing game
items.title_zh: Hop.earth：基于 OpenStreetMap 的赛车游戏
items.summary_en: An OpenStreetMap-based racing game that uses real-world map data to generate tracks. It demonstrates how open data can fuel creative, community-driven gameplay and novel player experiences. The project hints at future possibilities for user-generated routes and shareable content.
items.summary_zh: 一款利用 OpenStreetMap 数据生成真实世界赛道的赛车游戏，展示了开源地图数据如何推动社区驱动的创意玩法与独特的玩家体验。该项目还暗示了未来可让玩家自行提交路线并分享内容的潜力。

items.title_en: Flowise is shutting down
items.title_zh: Flowise 将停运
items.summary_en: Announces Flowise's shutdown, prompting users to plan migrations and weigh the longevity of AI tooling ecosystems. The note underscores the fragility of open tooling stacks and the need for sustainable maintenance.
items.summary_zh: Flowise 将停止运营，用户需规划迁移路径并评估开源工具生态的可持续性。体现 AI 工具生态的脆弱性与长期维护的重要性。

items.title_en: The Golden Age of British Ice Cream
items.title_zh: 英国冰淇淋的黄金时代
items.summary_en: Explores a historical era of British ice cream, tracing makers, flavors, and cultural influence. The piece ties culinary history to modern trends in artisanal production and branding.
items.summary_zh: 剖析英国冰淇淋的黄金时代，追溯其品牌、生产与文化影响，并将历史脉络与当代小众/手工制造趋势相连。

items.title_en: Show HN: SIMD Viterbi Decoder in Rust
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 Rust 实现的 SIMD Viterbi 解码器
items.summary_en: Showcases a high-performance Viterbi decoder implemented with SIMD in Rust, delivering faster decoding for error-correcting codes. A practical example of squeezing more throughput from modern CPUs for communications workloads.
items.summary_zh: 展示利用 SIMD 的 Rust 实现的 Viterbi 解码器，提升解码吞吐量。对需要高性能纠错码处理的场景尤具参考价值。

items.title_en: Cloudflare Wallets: the programmable wallet for the agentic Internet
items.title_zh: Cloudflare Wallets：面向智能互联网的可编程钱包
items.summary_en: Describes Cloudflare's Wallets as a programmable wallet enabling agents on the web to manage identity, payments, and data with programmable logic. Provides a glimpse into wallets becoming autonomous components of online apps.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare Wallets 描述一种可编程钱包，面向网络中的智能代理，支持身份、支付和数据的可编程处理。描绘钱包成为在线应用自治组件的愿景。

items.title_en: The applause that disrupted nothing – yet still led to an arrest
items.title_zh: 掌声未造成干扰却导致逮捕的事件
items.summary_en: An instance where harmless applause was deemed disruptive enough to warrant an arrest, illustrating potential overreach in enforcement and chilling effects on speech.
items.summary_zh: 一起看似无害的掌声被认定为扰乱而被逮捕的事件，揭示执法可能的过度与对言论自由的寒蝉效应。

items.title_en: Launch HN: EdotEnv (YC S26) – Quant Trading RL Envs to Teach LLMs Research
items.title_zh: Launch HN：EdotEnv（YC S26）— 用于教导 LLMs 的量化交易强化学习环境
items.summary_en: Introduces EdotEnv, a suite of reinforcement-learning environments for quantitative trading designed to train LLMs in research tasks. The project aims to standardize benchmarks and accelerate experiments at the intersection of finance, RL, and language models.
items.summary_zh: 推出 EdotEnv，一套用于量化交易的强化学习环境，旨在教导和评估 LLM 在金融研究中的应用，促进 RL 与语言模型研究的基准化。

items.title_en: Stateless MCP has recaptured my interest
items.title_zh: 对无状态 MCP 的再度关注
items.summary_en: A fresh look at a stateless MCP design, weighing its scalability and fault-tolerance benefits against traditional stateful approaches.
items.summary_zh: 作者重新审视无状态的 MCP 设计，权衡其在分布式系统中的可扩展性和容错性相对状态化方案的优势与折衷。文章探讨通过小幅架构改动即可提升性能和部署简化的可能性。

items.title_en: Amazon Germany to Accept Wero
items.title_zh: 亚马逊德国将接受 Wero
items.summary_en: Notes Amazon Germany's adoption of Wero as a payment method, signaling broader acceptance of alternative rails in Europe. Could drive pressure on other platforms to support newer payment ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 报道亚马逊德国将接受 Wero 支付方式，体现欧洲市场对新型支付通道的接受度提升。对金融科技生态有潜在推动作用。

items.title_en: Amiga clarifies Commodore rights and the future of AmigaOS
items.title_zh: Amiga 澄清 Commodore 权利与 AmigaOS 的未来
items.summary_en: Updates on Commodore rights and what they mean for AmigaOS development and licensing, shaping the roadmap for the classic platform's ongoing evolution. Includes statements about ownership, governance, and product strategy.
items.summary_zh: 更新 Commodore 权利与 AmigaOS 的未来走向，涉及授权、治理与产品路线图，对经典平台的持续发展产生影响。

items.title_en: The Law of Jante (2015)
items.title_zh: 简塔法则（Law of Jante）
items.summary_en: The piece revisits the Law of Jante, a tradition discouraging individual exceptionalism; it explores how cultural norms shape collaboration, risk-taking, and recognition in tech communities.
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾简塔法则，这一抑制个人突出、提倡集体均衡的文化规范，探讨其如何影响科技社区的协作、冒险精神与认可机制。

items.title_en: Dates That Don't Exist (2015)
items.title_zh: 不存在的日期（2015）
items.summary_en: Explores the concept of dates that don't exist in standard calendars and the implications for software design and data parsing. It highlights how edge-case dates can slip into real-world datasets and what developers can do to guard against them.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在常规日历中不存在的日期概念及其对软件设计和数据解析的影响。强调边缘日期如何进入实际数据集，以及开发者可以采取的防护措施。

items.title_en: Bubble Memory
items.title_zh: 泡沫存储
items.summary_en: Bubble memory was an early data storage technology using magnetic bubbles; explains how it worked and why it faded with semiconductor memory rising.
items.summary_zh: 泡沫存储是一种早期的数据存储技术，利用磁性“泡泡”来存储信息，介绍其工作原理及为何被半导体存储所替代。

items.title_en: Godox Transparent Viewfinder Camera C100
items.title_zh: Godox 透明取景器相机 C100
items.summary_en: Unveils Godox C100 with a transparent viewfinder, enabling creative workflows for videographers and VFX artists. The gadget hints at new ways to compose shots and monitor exposure in real time.
items.summary_zh: Godox C100 配备透明取景器，便于摄像与视觉效果工作流中的实时取景与曝光监控。

items.title_en: “Gravity is worth asking about”
items.title_zh: 值得问的重力问题
items.summary_en: Reflects on gravity as a deep, ongoing question in physics and philosophy, inviting readers to rethink assumptions about space, forces, and measurements.
items.summary_zh: 将重力视为物理学与哲学中的持续深刻问题，呼吁重新审视关于时空、力与测量的基本假设。

items.title_en: Video2NAND – Abusing video codecs for great computational power
items.title_zh: Video2NAND：利用视频编解码器实现强大计算能力
items.summary_en: Video2NAND demonstrates using video codecs as a form of programmable logic, repurposing codecs like VP8 to perform combinational logic. This challenges conventional silicon-centric thinking and could influence edge computing and hardware acceleration concepts.
items.summary_zh: Video2NAND 展示了将视频编解码器作为可编程逻辑的一种实现方式，改写了像 VP8 这样的编解码器以执行组合逻辑。这挑战了以硅为中心的传统思维，并可能影响边缘计算与硬件加速的未来思考。

items.title_en: Scaling NumPy on Free-Threaded Python
items.title_zh: 在无全局解释器锁的 Python 上扩展 NumPy 的规模
items.summary_en: Scaling NumPy on free-threaded Python by reducing GIL constraints and employing parallel strategies to improve throughput for numerical workloads.
items.summary_zh: 在无全局解释器锁的 Python 构建上扩展 NumPy，降低 GIL 影响并采用并行策略以提升数值计算吞吐量。

items.title_en: Why is it all in the kernel?
items.title_zh: 为什么一切都在内核中？
items.summary_en: Argues that kernel-level approaches dominate certain workloads and designs, discussing tradeoffs between performance, safety, and complexity. The piece prompts readers to rethink where computation should live in modern systems.
items.summary_zh: 讨论内核在现代系统中的主导地位及其优劣，探讨将计算放在内核中的性能、安全与复杂性权衡。促使读者重新思考架构分层。

items.title_en: Discovery of a multicomponent alloy forged by the Hiroshima atomic blast
items.title_zh: 广岛爆炸条件下形成的多组分合金发现
items.summary_en: Scientists report a multicomponent alloy formed by the intense conditions of the Hiroshima blast, revealing unexpected phase mixing. The finding sheds light on high-temperature, high-pressure metallurgy and the history of materials.
items.summary_zh: 研究者报道在广岛爆炸的极端条件下形成的多组分合金，揭示了出人意料的相混合现象。这一发现为高温高压冶金与材料史提供新线索。

items.title_en: Don't stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed
items.title_zh: 别早停：在内存速度下对源代码进行大小写折叠优化
items.summary_en: A deep-dive on optimizing case-folding in source code with attention to memory-speed characteristics. The piece argues for pushing certain optimizations deeper into the pipeline and avoiding premature early exits in compiler design to squeeze performance.
items.summary_zh: 文章深入探讨在内存速度下对源代码进行大小写折叠的优化。作者提出应将某些优化推向更低层级、避免过早放弃优化，以提升编译器性能。

items.title_en: Birduino: A card-triggered audio player for [learning] the birds
items.title_zh: Birduino：鸟类学习的卡片触发音频播放器
items.summary_en: Birduino is a card-triggered audio player for learning birds, a DIY project that uses physical cards to cue bird calls and teach field identification.
items.summary_zh: Birduino 是一个通过卡片触发鸟类声音的音频播放器，是一个用于野外识别学习的 DIY 项目。

items.title_en: The Pneumatics of Hero of Alexandria (1851)
items.title_zh: 希罗·亚历山大的气动学
items.summary_en: Delves into Hero of Alexandria's pneumatic devices and the roots of air-powered automation. The piece links ancient experiments to modern ideas about hydraulics, robotics, and the long arc from antiquity to engineering.
items.summary_zh: 介绍希罗·亚历山大时期的气动装置及其在气流和液体推动装置方面的早期应用。将古代实验与现代自动化、气动技术联系起来，揭示技术史的连续性。

items.title_en: Energizing a vacuum-tube flip-flop module from a 1948 IBM system
items.title_zh: 从1948年 IBM 系统为真空管触发器模块供能
items.summary_en: Energizing a vacuum-tube flip-flop module from a 1948 IBM system; reviving vintage hardware and exploring how early computing stored state using vacuum tubes.
items.summary_zh: 展示如何为 1948 年 IBM 系统中的真空管触发器模块供能，复兴复古硬件并探究早期计算机如何通过真空管存储状态。

items.title_en: GNU Hurd News 2026-Q2
items.title_zh: GNU Hurd 2026年第二季度更新
items.summary_en: GNU Hurd releases updates for 2026 Q2, outlining progress, fixes, and remaining challenges in the kernel-free UNIX-like OS project. The notes reflect ongoing efforts to revive the project after decades of development.
items.summary_zh: GNU Hurd 2026年第二季度更新公布进展、修复与面临的挑战，概述该内核未完成的UNIX风格操作系统的持续努力。

items.title_en: Rio-vt and librio: Rio's terminal engine, now embeddable
items.title_zh: Rio-vt 与 librio：Rio 的终端引擎现可嵌入
items.summary_en: Announces making Rio's terminal engine embeddable, enabling developers to embed a fast, feature-rich terminal in their apps. This paves the way for lightweight, portable UI backends and improved portability.
items.summary_zh: 宣布 Rio 的终端引擎可嵌入，方便开发者在应用中集成快速、功能丰富的终端界面。强调对移植性和轻量 UI 的潜在收益。

items.title_en: BSD Make extravaganza: Mandelbrot Set In bmake
items.title_zh: BSD Make 盛宴：在 bmake 中绘制 Mandelbrot 集
items.summary_en: Shows a Mandelbrot Set rendered within a BSD Makefile, a playful example of Make's expressive power and Turing-complete vibes, with code and visuals.
items.summary_zh: 展示在 BSD Makefile 中绘制 Mandelbrot 集的有趣示例，体现 Make 的表达能力与类图灵完备性，并附代码与可视化。

items.title_en: From boiling lead and black art: The history of mathematical typography (2017)
items.title_zh: 从煮铅到黑艺：数学排版史（2017）
items.summary_en: Recounts the history of mathematical typography from traditional metal type to digital typesetting, blending craft and mathematical rigor.
items.summary_zh: 回顾从铅字印刷到数字排版的数学排版史，展示技术演变如何影响数学表达与传播。
